title: Quasi-coherence under an isomorphism-induced derived equivalence
statement: Let s : X ≅ Y be a scheme isomorphism [def-pc-scheme]. Choose D(O_X) and D(O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category] in independent morphism universes. Let e be an equivalence of these derived categories with a natural isomorphism Q_X ⋙ e.functor ≅ (termwise pushforward along s.hom) ⋙ Q_Y. If E is in D_QCoh(O_Y), then every cohomology sheaf of e.inverse.obj E is quasi-coherent, i.e. e.inverse.obj E belongs to D_QCoh(O_X). No perfection or choice of open-site derived categories is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08EB, affine isomorphism transport in lem-pc-perfect-affine-finite-presentation; Tag 08CM (definition of perfection)

proof.text: Take a cochain representative P of e.inverse.obj E.obj using DerivedCategory.Q.objPreimage and its isomorphism. Map this isomorphism through e.functor, compose with the counit, and invert the supplied comparison at P. This identifies Q_Y(s_* P) with E.obj.

source.place: Tag 08EB, affine isomorphism transport in lem-pc-perfect-affine-finite-presentation; Tag 08CM (definition of perfection)

proof.text: Construct the sheaf equivalence with inverse pushforwards using pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId. Its forward functor F is exact. Compose the inverse of F.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso, the inverse Q-homology factorization, and homology of the preceding isomorphism. This identifies F(Hⁿ(P)) with Hⁿ(E), so the former is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Tag 08EB, affine isomorphism transport in lem-pc-perfect-affine-finite-presentation; Tag 08CM (definition of perfection)

proof.text: The inverse morphism s.inv is affine. Apply the quasi-coherence clause of lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi to F(Hⁿ(P)), then transfer through the inverse of the module equivalence unit to Hⁿ(P). Finally transfer through the homology factorization and the representative isomorphism to Hⁿ(e.inverse.obj E.obj). Do this for every integer n.

lean.statement:
theorem scheme_iso_derived_inverse_preserves_qcoh {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ≅ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (e : schemeDerivedCategory X ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (he : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward s.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (e.inverse.obj E.obj)
